description: Shared E-Scooter Parking Corrals is a dataset listed in City of New York open data portal (data.cityofnewyork.us), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of New York. This dataset contains all designated parking corral locations for shared electric scooters (e-scooters) in the East Bronx and Eastern Queens service areas. E-Scooter parking corrals are marked on the roadbed or sidewalk where shared e-scooters operated by Lime, Veo, and Bird can be parked. Coverage: New York City. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are electric, scooter, parking, e-scooter, bronx. The table has 7 columns. Attribution on the portal: Department of Transportation (DOT). The portal shows 2026-09-01 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cityofnewyork-us-portal.
